Advantages of Mobile Crushing Station
1.High Crushing Efficiency & Output: Features powerful jaw and box crushers to handle hard rock and limestone. Optimized cavity design ensures high throughput and superior grain shape, meeting diverse aggregate production needs for mining sites.

Application Fields of Mobile Crushing Stations
1.Mining & Quarrying: Primary and secondary crushing of hard rocks like granite, basalt, and iron ore. Essential for large-scale open-pit mining and mineral processing.
2.Construction Waste Recycling: Efficiently processing demolition debris, concrete, and bricks into reusable aggregates for sustainable urban development.
3.Infrastructure Projects: On-site material production for highway, railway, and bridge construction, providing high-quality roadbase and asphalt aggregates.
4.Aggregate Production: Crushing river stones and limestone for the sand and gravel industry to supply high-standard concrete for building projects.
5.Cement & Chemical Industry: Processing raw materials such as limestone and gypsum directly at the quarry site to streamline the supply chain.
6.Earthwork & Landscaping: Ideal for site leveling and trenching projects where portable crushing of excavated rock is required.




FAQ of Mobile Crushing Station
Q: How to choose between a Jaw and Box type mobile crusher for my project?
A: It depends on your material. Use our Jaw Crusher for primary crushing of hard rocks like granite or basalt. Choose the Box/Impact Crusher for secondary processing of softer materials like limestone or construction waste to get a better cubic final shape.
Q: Can this machine handle heavy construction waste with rebar?
A: Yes. Our mobile stations are designed for recycling. The reinforced box crusher efficiently separates concrete from rebar, while optional magnetic separators remove metal, preventing downtime and turning demolition debris into profitable aggregates.
Q: How do I manage maintenance and spare parts in remote mining areas?
A: We prioritize low-maintenance design. All wear parts use high-manganese steel for extended life. The hydraulic opening system allows for quick inspection, and we provide a global-standard parts list to ensure your operation never stops for long.
Q: Is the mobile station easy to transport between different job sites?
A: Absolutely. Designed for maximum mobility, our units feature a compact crawler or wheeled chassis. You can move the plant via low-bed trailer and have it operational within hours, significantly reducing transportation costs and setup time.
Q: How can I ensure the final output size meets my specific roadbase requirements?
A: The discharge opening is fully adjustable. Whether you need 0-5mm sand or 20-40mm ballast, you can easily tune the settings. This flexibility ensures you meet strict project specs for highways, bridges, or building construction.

If headset power off, please connect the headset with your included USB cable and plug it into a USB power source for charging.

Q:How to solve the problem that the mobile phone prompts that it cannot connect?

A:Delete the pairing record on the mobile phone, and then search for pairing and connect again.

Q:How to solve the problem that there is no sound when listening to music or calling?

A: There is a settings icon on the right side of the Bluetooth connection name on Android phones. Click to enter, turn off the mobile phone audio and media audio, and then turn them on again. If there is still no sound, please re-pair the earphones with the mobile phone.

Q: Why is there a delay in video or games?

A: Affected by factors such as the use environment, network, and mobile phone Codec, there will be different degrees of delay when the mobile phone transmits audio data to the earphone.

Q: How to solve the problem of stuck or intermittent sound?

A:If there are a lot of Wi-Fi, 5G and 4G signals, high-power electrical appliances around, it may cause stuck and intermittent sound. Please Change the environment or re-pairing can solve the problem.

Q: How do I update the version of my headphones?

A: Application: Device,Settings,Firmware Upgrade. If it prompts that the upgrade cannot be made, it indicates that it is already the latest version.

Q: How to install the Driver?

A: Please visit the QCY Official website -- find "Support Center"-- "Product Support" --"Heroad" -- find "VT200 Pro", then click Documents & Drivers, and download "Heroad VT200 Pro PC Driver". (compatible with Windows 10/11 operating systems but only supported on Windows systems). Follow the installation guide to complete installation and unlock all functions.

Q: The headphones can't connect to the APP?

A: You can set the language of the application to English before connecting the headphones.
